apps.name: Kodi
apps.description: Open-source media center from the XBMC Foundation. 21.3 Omega is the current stable release (22 Piers is still in beta). Official 32-bit ARM build, which runs on every Fire TV.

apps.name: VLC
apps.description: VideoLAN's open-source player. Plays almost any file, network share or stream.

apps.name: Just Player
apps.description: Lightweight open-source video player built on ExoPlayer. Always pulls the newest GitHub release.

apps.name: Jellyfin
apps.description: Official Android TV client for a Jellyfin media server. Always pulls the newest GitHub release.

apps.name: Stremio
apps.description: Media hub for your own library and official add-ons.

apps.name: Plex
apps.description: Client for a Plex Media Server, plus free live and on-demand channels.

apps.name: TiviMate
apps.description: IPTV player for your own subscription or playlist. Official release; Premium is bought inside the app.

apps.name: IPTV Smarters Pro

apps.name: OTT Navigator
apps.description: IPTV player with a TV guide. Official release.

apps.name: Tubi
apps.description: Free movies and TV with ads.

apps.name: Pluto TV
apps.description: Free live channels and on-demand shows.

apps.name: Peacock
apps.description: NBCUniversal's streaming service.

apps.name: Paramount+
apps.description: Paramount's streaming service.

apps.name: SmartTube
apps.description: Open-source YouTube client for TV boxes with ad and sponsor skipping. Always pulls the newest stable GitHub release.

apps.name: Netflix
apps.description: Official Netflix app for TV. Needs a Netflix subscription.

apps.name: Disney+
apps.description: Official Disney+ app. Needs a Disney+ subscription.
